text: Export of our memory store keeps hanging at 90% and eventually times out on large datasets.
Third time this week our nightly export job has failed with a timeout.
Export timeout again today. This is blocking our data warehouse sync every single night now.
Search results have gotten noticeably slower since Monday, queries that used to be instant now take seconds.
Our integration is getting 429 rate limit errors constantly during peak hours this week.
Support responded to my urgent ticket in minutes and walked me through a workaround. Really appreciated it.
Would be great to have per-namespace TTL configuration instead of one global expiry.
Mobile app crashes every time I try to sync while offline mode is on.
We were double-charged on this month's invoice — both the annual and monthly plan fees hit our card.
Billing shows a duplicate charge for the same subscription period again, same as last time.
Requested a refund for an incorrect charge two weeks ago and still haven't heard back.
The pricing page doesn't explain what counts as a 'memory unit,' had to email sales just to understand our bill.
Onboarding was smooth this week, docs got our new engineer to a working prototype in under an hour.
Please add SAML support for enterprise SSO, our IT team requires it for renewal.
Docs for the Python SDK are still out of date, the retrieve() example throws a deprecation warning.
Got locked out of our workspace after an SSO change, support couldn't restore access for hours. Unacceptable for a paid plan.
Really love the new dashboard redesign, so much easier to find what I need now.
The CLI tools make local dev testing painless, best part of the whole platform for us.
Please add a bulk-delete API so we don't have to loop single deletes for GDPR erasure requests.
Would like audit logs for who accessed which memory records, needed for our SOC2 review.
Support fixed my issue live on a call in under ten minutes today. Genuinely impressed every time.
Just a neutral note, usage has been stable this week, no complaints and nothing exciting either.
Minor gripe: the API key page is still one click too deep in the new navigation.
The webinar on retrieval strategies this week was excellent, the team clearly knows the space well.
